verdict.rationale: Apple's official spec page publishes concrete numbers — 153GB/s memory bandwidth and 32GB memory capacity — alongside unified memory architecture description, letting a developer size memory-bound workloads; these figures are also independently corroborated by community discussion of LLM throughput implications. Missing for 10: explicit memory technology/type designation (e.g., LPDDR5X spec) is not stated, only 'unified memory' terminology.
